# Dequeue Element

![Dequeue Element function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/synchronization/queue/08_Dequeue%20Element.svg)

[Synchronization functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Removes and returns the head element in FIFO order. An empty queue waits cooperatively: -1 means no deadline, 0 an immediate attempt. Ordinary timeout is distinguished from invalidation and from a successfully received message. Queue&lt;T&gt; is an execution resource reference; element is the ordinary T value. Public FROG target compilation remains unavailable.

## Studio authoring profile

Contract status: **partial**. The connector below describes Studio authoring; execution availability is stated separately.

Removes and returns the head element in FIFO order. An empty queue waits cooperatively: -1 means no deadline, 0 an immediate attempt. Ordinary timeout is distinguished from invalidation and from a successfully received message.

## Queue behavior

Removes and returns one head message in FIFO order. An empty queue waits cooperatively. A normal timeout is distinct from invalidation and from successful receipt; check timed out? and error out before consuming element.

Queue&lt;T&gt; is a nominal execution-resource access reference. The complete T schema is invariant; an Array, Cluster or Enum message remains one T value. Collection outputs add one outer rank-1 Array.

Timeout is I32 milliseconds: -1 waits without a deadline, 0 attempts immediately, and nonnegative values bound the wait. Waiting is cooperative. Invalidation wakes waits with an error.
